_meta.title: Cardinal Quest campus location catalog
_meta.derivedFrom: Cardinal campus app location list (working doc, Oct 30, 2026). Entries, points, OSM ids, scene files, podcast segments and notes are taken from that doc; nothing here is a new historical claim.
_meta.coordinateSource: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup run for the working doc on Oct 30, 2026. Each point is a map point, not a surveyed position; confirm on the map before it becomes an unlock zone. Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

flags.offCampus: true only where the working doc says the place is off campus
flags.privateProperty: private property; exterior only, never an unlock zone inside the lot
flags.exteriorOnly: pin and audio from outside only
flags.linear: a line feature (zone along it, no pin)
flags.needsPoint: the doc has no point for this place yet; lat and lon stay null until one is confirmed
flags.noPin: deliberately no map pin or address; audio mention only

locations.name: El Palo Alto (the double redwood)
locations.note: Off campus (City of Palo Alto, by Caltrain). Prologue stop. GN shots 1.02 and 1.03 are set here.

locations.name: San Francisquito Creek (campus edge)
locations.note: Linear feature: better as a "walk along" audio zone than a pin. The doc takes no single OSM point; it suggests using a point on the creek near El Palo Alto.

locations.name: Red Barn (Palo Alto Stock Farm, Muybridge track)
locations.note: Ep 5, 06 says "shot on this farm". The 1880 zoopraxiscope showing (Ep 8, 04. The Studio) was at the San Francisco mansion, not here.

locations.name: Main Quad
podcastSegments: Ep 4, 07. The Story of Our Streets
Ep 5, 01. The Spire and the Plank
locations.note: Central hub; most tour routes will pass it.

locations.name: Memorial Church
podcastSegments: Ep 5, 01. The Spire and the Plank
locations.note: Strong graphic-novel set: before/after spire.

locations.name: Palm Drive
locations.note: Point is the OSM way for Palm Drive. The doc lists Palm Drive and the Memorial Arch site as one row; the arch site is a separate entry (memorial-arch-site) because it needs its own point.

locations.name: Memorial Arch site (head of Palm Drive)

bookScenes.context: "Memorial Arch stood at its head until 1906"

locations.note: The arch site needs its own point at the head of Palm Drive; not looked up yet.

locations.name: Encina Hall
locations.note: One building, three eras: 1891 dorm, 1906 quake, 1970s licensing office. Ep 7, 07 has the licensing trailer "behind Encina Hall".

locations.name: Stanford Mausoleum
locations.note: Pairs with the Arizona Garden (arizona-cactus-garden). The doc lists the Mausoleum and the Angel of Grief in one row; the Angel has its own entry (angel-of-grief).

locations.name: Angel of Grief
locations.note: Angel of Grief is in the game but never named in the book. Listed with the Stanford Mausoleum in the doc, so the book scene and podcast segment are the Mausoleum row's. Pairs with the Arizona Garden (arizona-cactus-garden).

locations.name: Cantor Arts Center (Leland Stanford Jr. Museum)

bookScenes.context: Museum Way, "the memorial Jane Stanford built for her son"

podcastSegments: Ep 5, 01. The Spire and the Plank
locations.note: Ep 4, 02: the boy's room moved into the museum in 1893. Ep 5, 01: the golden spike "sits in the art museum". Good object-based audio stop (the spike).

locations.name: Hoover Tower
locations.note: The library's origin scene is still a gap in the book (outline check, Oct 29).

locations.name: HP Garage, 367 Addison Ave
locations.note: Off campus, private property. Exterior only: never an unlock zone inside the lot.

locations.name: Stanford Research Park (Hansen Way, Page Mill Rd)
locations.note: Point is Hansen Way (OSM way). Large area; a drive-by or bike stop rather than walking.

locations.name: Applied Electronics Laboratory (April Third sit-in, 1969)
locations.note: Not looked up: the lab's building and its current name need confirming first. Don't place a pin until the building is confirmed from a Stanford source.

locations.name: Gates Computer Science Building
locations.note: OSM has a second "Gates Building" node nearby (5686381081); use the building outline.

locations.name: 3000 Sand Hill Road
locations.note: Off campus, on Stanford land. The OSM way is matched to "Restaurant 3000" at that address. Point is one building in the complex; fine for a zone.

locations.name: Rosewood Sand Hill
locations.note: Hotel; exterior only.

locations.name: Stanford Daily building (Lorry I. Lokey Stanford Daily Building)
locations.note: Check that the 2022 reporting was based in this building before using "here" in narration.

locations.name: Street-name walk (Lasuen Mall, Serra, Gálvez, Alvarado Row, Jane Stanford Way, Governor's Ave, Electioneer)
podcastSegments: Ep 4, 07. The Story of Our Streets
Ep 7, 06. The Story of Our Streets
locations.note: Point is Lasuen Mall only; the other streets were not looked up and have no point. The coda is already a walking tour; it could be the app's closing route.

locations.name: Arizona Cactus Garden
locations.note: Not in the book or in the podcast scripts searched. Game-only for now (Cardinal Quest v0.1 doc has cited history). Pairs with the Stanford Mausoleum.

locations.name: Lake Lagunita
locations.note: Not in the book or in the podcast scripts searched. Game-only for now.

locations.name: Hanna House
locations.note: Not in the book or in the podcast scripts searched. Tour-only residence; game-only for now.

locations.name: Google garage (Menlo Park)
locations.note: No pin on purpose. A private home. Mention in audio only; no map pin or address in the app.
